name: Patch multiple Worker script secrets
description: Patch multiple Worker script secrets Create, update, or delete multiple secrets on a Worker script in a single operation using JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7396). PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/scripts/{script_name}/secrets-bulk
context:
PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/scripts/{script_name}/secrets-bulk
Create, update, or delete multiple secrets on a Worker script in a single operation using JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7396). This operation creates a single version with all changes included. Prefer this API instead of changing many secrets individually. Usage: - To create or update a secret, set its value to a secret object. - To delete a secret, set its value to `null`. - Secrets not included in the request are left unchanged.
Required: account_id (path); script_name (path); body (body)
